identity.life_stage: married, two children, nonprofit program director

engagement.interaction_backstory: She runs after-school programming for two hundred kids and she builds every single event on a playlist. She found the children's catalog and put it in three sites within a month. She wants to know what she is licensed to do with it in a public program and there is no page that tells her.

depth.core_contradiction: Fights for two hundred other people's children and outsources her own two to a schedule.
depth.wound: She got out of this neighborhood and came back on purpose, and half the people she grew up with read that as pity.
depth.longing: To be from here and not have to prove it constantly.
depth.faith_journey: Came to faith at nineteen in a campus ministry, not at home; a chosen faith, and she still feels slightly like a guest in it.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Let me be clear"; makes a bullet list out loud; laughs suddenly and fully.
depth.open_doubt: Whether her work is ministry or whether she just prefers being useful to being known.

social_graph.note: teaches at the high school; the calm one
200; she knows about forty by name and it bothers her that it is not all of them

depth.emotional_weather_default: Driven and warm; flat on Sunday nights.
depth.daily_texture: Grant deadlines, the Red Line, two hundred permission slips, dinner at 8:15.
depth.sensory_anchor: A gym full of kids singing something they did not know they knew.
depth.living_arc: A funding cliff in March that she has told nobody about.
